description.zh: 背景素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
description.en: The video-on-demand resource ID of the background material. Obtain this value from the ApsaraVideo VOD console.

description.zh: 背景素材的资源访问url，与资源id二选一传入
description.en: The access URL of the background material. Specify either this parameter or the resource ID.

description.zh:
背景素材类型：
- VOD 点播视频
- PIC 图片
- LIVE 直播流
description.en:
The type of the background material. Valid values:
- VOD: video-on-demand video.
- PIC: image.
- LIVE: live stream.

description.zh:
预览画面高度，单位：px

预览画面宽度x高度仅支持以下规格：

- 横屏流畅 360P 640x360
- 竖屏流畅 360P 360x640
- 横屏标清 480P 854x480
- 竖屏标清 480P 480x854
- 横屏高清 720P 1280x720
- 竖屏高清 720P 720x1280
- 横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080
- 竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920
description.en:
The height of the preview screen. Unit: px.

The width × height of the preview screen supports only the following specifications:

- Landscape low definition 360P: 640 × 360
- Portrait low definition 360P: 360 × 640
- Landscape standard definition 480P: 854 × 480
- Portrait standard definition 480P: 480 × 854
- Landscape high definition 720P: 1280 × 720
- Portrait high definition 720P: 720 × 1280
- Landscape ultra-high definition 1080P: 1920 × 1080
- Portrait ultra-high definition 1080P: 1080 × 1920.

description.zh: 源流抠图后的布局位置信息
description.en: The layout position information of the source stream after image matting.

description.zh:
抠图类型：
- green 绿幕抠图
- blue 蓝幕抠图
- complex 实景抠图
description.en:
The image matting type. Valid values:
- green: green screen matting.
- blue: blue screen matting.
- complex: real-scene matting.

description.zh: 多媒体素材的布局位置信息
description.en: The layout position information of the multimedia material.

description.zh: 多媒体素材的点播资源id，从点播控制台获取
description.en: The video-on-demand resource ID of the multimedia material. Obtain this value from the ApsaraVideo VOD console.

description.zh: 多媒体素材的资源访问url，与资源id二选一传入
description.en: The access URL of the multimedia material. Specify either this parameter or the resource ID.

description.zh:
多媒体素材类型：
- VOD 点播视频
- PIC 图片
- LIVE 直播流
description.en:
The type of the multimedia material. Valid values:
- VOD: video-on-demand video.
- PIC: image.
- LIVE: live stream.

description.zh: 虚拟演播模板名称，不可重复
description.en: The name of the virtual studio template. The name must be unique.
The width of the preview screen. Unit: px.

descriptions.zh: ><notice>轻量化虚拟演播功能处于公测阶段，单个用户最多创建300个模板。暂时免费使用，公测结束后将正常收费，具体时间另行通知。></notice>
descriptions.en: ><notice>The lightweight virtual studio feature is in public preview. Each user can create up to 300 templates. The feature is free of charge during the public preview. After the public preview ends, standard fees will apply. The specific date will be announced separately.></notice>.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-ai-studio --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --studio-name stu02 --description template_1080 --width 1920 --height 1080 --background-type VOD --background-resource-id d0eb493192c771efba644531858c0102 --background-resource-url https://xxx.com/1.mp4 --media-type VOD --media-resource-id d0eb493192c771efba644531858c0102 --media-resource-url https://xxx.com/2.mp4 --media-layout PositionY=0.0 HeightNormalized=0.5 PositionX=0.0 --matting-type complex --matting-layout PositionY=0.3 HeightNormalized=0.5 PositionX=0.3 --region cn-hangzhou
